title: Gateway record (one line of reps/<n>/gateway.jsonl)
description: One record per request the harness sent. The gateway has a single upstream and always forwards to the pinned model. Request and response bodies are stored only as hashes.

outcome.description: ok: answered by the model. upstream_rejected: the provider refused the request (for example, context too long). budget_exhausted: refused by the gateway because the rep's budget is spent. bad_request: not a valid chat-completions request.

upstream_attempts.description: 1 + transparent retries of upstream 5xx, 429 or transport errors. 0 when the gateway answered without contacting the provider.

model_rewritten.description: True when the request named a model other than the pinned one. It was served by the pinned model either way.

input_tokens.description: All prompt tokens, including cached ones.

arguments_valid_json.description: How many of the returned tool calls had arguments that parse as a JSON object.

totals.description: Rep-wide counters after this request, as the gateway used them for budget enforcement.
